title: model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama / Mistral / Qwen (GQA/MQA tuning, kernels, KV cache, batching)
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR implements a set of model-specific runtime optimizations targeting Llama (and its MQA variants), Mistral, and Qwen families. Motivation: despite our generic kernel selection and batching infrastructure, we observed persistent tail latency and throughput regressions for certain open models due to attention layout differences (MQA vs GQA), rotary/rope embedding quirks, and KV cache fragmentation on long-lived streaming sessions. This change bundle includes: 1) New kernel selector heuristics that prefer GQA-optimized kernels for grouped-query models and auto-fallback to MQA kernels when beneficial; 2) Compact KV cache layout for MQA/GQA models to avoid page-aligned holes when tokens are appended frequently in streaming; 3) Continuous-batching scheduler heuristics to avoid mixing small MQA heads with large GQA heads in the same micro-batch (reduces kernel thrash); 4) Model-specific rotary/rope handling for Qwen to avoid extra transpose operations on attention state; 5) Light-weight runtime-level quantization hinting (GQA-friendly int8 path preference for Llama-4-compat variants) and tuned GEMM tile sizes for common sequence length distributions. The description below is a single continuous string and includes the test/benchmark summary and rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] Kernel selector and kernel table updates - [x] KV cache compaction implementation + unit tests - [x] Scheduler heuristic for continuous batching + integration tests - [x] Qwen rotary/rope fast-path - [x] Benchmark harness updates and perf numbers - [x] Docs/console notes for model-specific flags Rollout plan: feature-flag gated on runtime.flag.model_quirks_v2; staged rollout to dedicated pools first, then hosted API behind traffic ramp. Related Linear tasks: ENG-1284, ENG-1299. Notes: this PR intentionally does not include invasive changes to the model loader; all changes are runtime-only and gated by config. CI initially failed on an edge-case unit test for kv-compaction under multi-threaded eviction; fixed in follow-up commit. See commits below for details.
commits: a1f3d9b: kernel: add gqa vs mqa heuristics and kernel score table (runtime/kernel_selector.cc)
b4e29a2: kvcache: compact allocation and reclaim logic, add unit tests (runtime/kv_cache.cc)
c6f8d3e: scheduler: avoid co-batching MQA-heavy and GQA-heavy requests (runtime/scheduler.cc)
d2b0f44: qwen: rotary/rope fast-path to remove redundant transposes (runtime/models/qwen_adapter.cc)
e9a11c7: quant: add hint paths for GQA-friendly int8 kernels and tune gemm tiles (runtime/quant_paths.cc)
f3c77b1: tests: add perf harness configs for llama-4, mistral-7b, qwen-7b; update expected latency baselines
release_notes: Performance: Improved throughput and tail latency for Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families by introducing GQA/MQA-aware kernel selection, KV cache compaction, and batching heuristics. See runtime.feature_flags: model_quirks_v2 for rollout.
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can we add a short microbenchmark comparing merged GQA vs MQA kernel throughput for Llama-4 int8? (author: added in commit f3c77b1)
Priya Narayanan: The scheduler heuristic looks good but please add a comment explaining why we avoid mixing MQA heads with GQA at micro-batch level (author: added explanatory comment and unit test)
Ben O'Leary: CI flake on kv_compaction under heavy eviction; repro and fixed in b4e29a2 commit
summary_benchmarks: LLama-4-compat (seq512, batch8): throughput +22% (int8 GQA path), p99 latency -18%
Mistral-7B (seq1024, batch4): throughput +14%, p99 latency -12% after scheduler batching changes
Qwen-7B (streaming, avg seq 800): tail p99 improved -25% due to rotary fast-path and KV compaction
notes: Gating: runtime.flag.model_quirks_v2=false by default for hosted; enabled on dedicated pools and internal perf lab. Operators can override per-deployment via runtime.conf: model_quirks=(qwen,llama,mistral). Observability: added per-model counters for kernel fallback and kv_compact_evictions to /metrics and console dashboards.
manual_testing_instructions: 1) Start runtime with feature flag enabled. 2) Run tests/benchmarks/llama_4_int8.sh and tests/benchmarks/qwen_streaming.sh. 3) Monitor metrics: runtime_kernel_selector_fallback_total, runtime_kv_compact_evictions_total. 4) Validate tail latency on streaming scenarios.
changelog_entry: runtime(kernel): add model-specific kernel selection and KV cache compaction to improve Llama/Mistral/Qwen performance (ENG-1284)
